title: Things I want in a modern relational query language
summary: A thoughtful exploration of desired features for a modern relational query language, examining what improvements and innovations the author believes would better serve developers compared to traditional SQL approaches.
problem_solved: Addresses the limitations and friction points developers experience when working with traditional SQL in modern application development.
why_valuable: Provides practical insights into evolving database query paradigms to meet contemporary developer needs for better readability, expressiveness, and developer experience.
